instructions.content: Identify the target config file(s) from the request intent.
Read the current config state and precedence (project against global) before editing.
Apply minimal configuration edits with an explicit rationale.
Validate syntax after each edit with `jq . opencode.json`.
Run `opencode run "test"` as a smoke test and confirm the expected behaviour.
If errors surface, re-read config precedence before widening permissions.
NEVER commit API keys directly in config; reference them with `baseEnv`.
NEVER use broad filesystem or shell permissions by default; scope paths and allowlist commands.
NEVER use ambiguous model names; use provider-qualified or exact model identifiers.
NEVER skip verification after permission changes.
NEVER put AGENTS.md instructions in opencode.json, or runtime settings in AGENTS.md.
NEVER use global config for project-specific settings; put them in the project-root opencode.json.
NEVER set a provider model to `default: true` without a fully qualified `id`.
NEVER ignore the precedence order when diagnosing config issues; audit from the top of the chain first.
Prefer least-privilege permissions and widen them only when required.
Provider order matters when more than one provider can satisfy a model name.
